_note: woo-publish-decision-from-the-case (found by the e2e Woo journey, portaliq#1001). The Woo document assessment wrote to `woo_assessment_schema`, and no shipped schema ever set that key, so every assessment answered 400. The slug is NOT `wooAssessment`: opencatalogi ships a schema with that slug, and slugs are global on a shared OpenRegister. The properties are exactly what WOODocumentAssessmentService and WOOAnonymisationAssistService write.

wooDocumentAssessment.title: Woo document assessment
wooDocumentAssessment.description: Per document of a Woo request case: may it be disclosed, and on which grounds is it withheld.

caseRef.title: Case
caseRef.description: The Woo request case the document belongs to.

classification.title: Classification
classification.description: Whether the document is public, partly public or not public.

weigeringsgronden.title: Grounds for refusal
weigeringsgronden.description: The Woo articles (5.1 and 5.2) the document or its parts are withheld under.

redactedDocumentRef.title: Redacted document
redactedDocumentRef.description: The redacted version of a partly public document, the only version that may be published.

redactionProposal.title: Redaction proposal
redactionProposal.description: The proposed passages to redact, and the review of that proposal.
